headline: Sources: Colts' Josh Downs requests trade; Jonathan Taylor hasn't, per coach
summary: Colts wide receiver Josh Downs is requesting a trade amid the team's rebuilding efforts, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Wednesday.

headline: Josh Downs on trade request: "I'm open to whatever"
summary: Downs did not explicitly confirm he'd requested a trade, but he didn't reject the notion of playing elsewhere when asked on Wednesday.

headline: NFL trade deadline grades: DeForest Buckner, Quenton Nelson dealt by Colts, more
summary: Does Buckner make the 49ers Super Bowl hopefuls? Will Quenton Nelson upgrade the Seahawks' O-line? We're grading NFL trades ahead of November's deadline.

headline: Liam Coen: Colts traded away two good players right before we play them, can't deny that
summary: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen acknowledged that his team's task got a little easier when the Colts traded away two of their top players, offensive lineman Quenton Nelson and defensive lineman DeForest Buckner.

headline: Bengals Not Planning To Trade Shemar Stewart
summary: Although defensive end Shemar Stewart has been a nonfactor for the 4-2 Bengals, teams are reportedly eyeing him as the Nov. 10 trade deadline approaches. It appears those clubs will have to look elsewhere, though, as the Bengals are not planning to deal Stewart, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports. Stewart, a polarizing prospect […]

headline: Giants GM Joe Schoen on trades: We're looking, but has to make sense now and in future
summary: The Giants hit their bye week in first place in the NFC East with a 4-2-1 record and that's made the prospect of bolstering the roster in the trade market a popular topic of conversation around the team.
